objective: Complete and deploy guest Fastrr payment, verified confirmation page and admin order/customer integration
acceptance_criteria: No account login required for Fastrr checkout
Credentials stored server-only in Vercel production
Guest return verified against provider before success/cart reconciliation
Provider failures do not fabricate success
Build and tests pass, deployed guest checkout reaches provider without charging or submitting a real order
Confirmed order customer name, email, phone, address, line items and payment references appear in admin
Confirmation page includes order reference, total and Back to home
authorization: User explicitly requested completing checkout/payment, guest ordering and pushing variables to Vercel; production activation and necessary deployment authorized. No real purchase requested.

decisions.action: Use signed guest session plus provider order-details verification
decisions.evidence: Public Postman documents SUCCESS separately from payment_status; redirect query alone is not payment proof

decisions.evidence: Provider Order List authenticated successfully with zero completed orders; private storage created; deterministic database keys make retries safe
